doc:
### PROPOSAL-05 — Retro Synthwave / Neon 80s - **slug**: `synthwave` - **Vibe**: Cruise the neon grid at midnight — magenta, cyan, purple glow, sunset gradients, and chrome trim. - **Best for**: Earnings dashboard after dark and launch/flash moments that deserve spectacle. Adjectives: electric, nostalgic, theatrical. - **Palette** (dark theme, `is_dark: true`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#12051f` | Deep violet-black canvas | | `--bg-surface` | `#1d0b33` | Panel fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#2a1250` | Raised panels, modals | | `--border-subtle` | `#3a1e66` | Subtle neon hairlines | | `--border-default` | `#532a8f` | Standard neon borders | | `--border-focus` | `#ff2bd6` | Hot-magenta focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#fdf2ff` | High-contrast headings | | `--text-secondary` | `#cfa8f0` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#8d63b8` | Captions, helper text | | `--color-action` | `#ff2bd6` | Hot-magenta primary action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#e21dbb` | Action hover (deeper magenta) | | `--color-earnings` | `#ffd319` | Sunset-yellow earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#e6bc00` | Earnings hover (deeper gold) | | `--color-automation` | `#3ce0ff` | Neon-cyan automation accents | | `--color-alert` | `#ff9f1c` | Hot-orange warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#ff3b5c` | Neon-red destructive states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(255, 43, 214, 0.35)` | Strong neon aura behind action icons | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(255, 211, 25, 0.30)` | Strong neon aura behind earnings icons | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(60, 224, 255, 0.30)` | Strong neon aura behind automation icons | - **Typography**: Display: `"Audiowide", "Orbitron", sans-serif` for KPI numerals and big headings — squared, futuristic, slightly wide. Sans: `"Rajdhani", "Exo 2", system-ui, sans-serif` at 500-700 with `letter-spacing: 0.02em`; uppercase micro-labels at 0.08em. Mono: `"Share Tech Mono", "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` for logs and IDs. Numerals `tabular-nums`. - **Radii & Borders**: Rounded-but-glowy: cards 12px, buttons pill or 8px. Borders are 1-2px neon with a matching outer glow (`box-shadow: 0 0 12px`). Card tops get a 2px bright "sunset line" in magenta or cyan. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Neon fill + 2px brighter border + outer glow; near-black text (`#12051f`) for contrast. Hover intensifies the glow and raises it. Secondary = transparent fill, neon border, subtle glow. Focus = 2px `--border-focus` plus glow ring. - **Cards**: Dark surfaces with a 1px neon border and soft outer glow; top edge carries the 2px sunset line. Empty states and headers may layer a perspective-grid motif. - **Badges/Status**: Neon-outlined pills with a glowing dot; publishing = pulsing magenta dot with glow; published = cyan glow. All badges read as "lit" elements. - **Tables**: Header row runs a sunset gradient strip (yellow to magenta) with dark text; zebra rows very subtle; row hover = left 3px neon bar. Numbers glow slightly at high values. - **Forms/Inputs**: Dark fields, 1px neon border; focus = border brightens + soft glow. Labels in Rajdhani uppercase. - **Loading**: A horizontal "synth scanner" line sweeping across a dark track, or three neon dots pulsing with glow in sequence. - **Signature detail**: Chrome-gradient text on primary headings plus the sunset gradient + perspective grid horizon used in empty states and the login/marketing surfaces — pure 80s. - **Motion & Animation**: Cinematic and slow-glow: elements fade in with `opacity 0 -> 1` plus `filter: blur(8px) -> blur(0)` and scale 1.02 to 1, 350ms. Neon glows pulse on hover. No hard snaps. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
TODAY'S EARNINGS $412.80
```
